The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''4004 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[Post-Manderon period|era]] just before the [[Old Sith Wars]]. That year, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Thon]] accepted [[Oss Wilum]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and brought him to [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]].<ref name="Saga 2">[[Tales of the Jedi 4|''Tales of the Jedi'' 4]]</ref>
